nature_of_ownership: Held through Cyberjoy Holding Limited and Funtery Holding Limited
footnote_text: Class A ordinary shares were acquired as consideration for the sale of ordinary shares of Techforge Co., Ltd., a Cayman Islands exempted company. || Includes (i) 7,799,056 Class A ordinary shares held of record by Funtery Holding Limited ("Funtery"), a British Virgin Islands company that is (a) 33.3% owned by Cyberjoy holding Limited ("Cyberjoy"), a British Virgin Islands company wholly owned by Mr. Xie Feng; and (b) 66.7% of the equity interests are owned by a trust established under the laws of Singapore, with Cyberjoy acting as the beneficiary and having the sole voting and dispositive power over the respective equity interests; (ii) 11,000,000 Class A ordinary shares acquired as reported herein and issued to Cyberjoy; and (iii) 7,799,057 Class A ordinary shares issuable upon the conversion of 7,799,057 Class B ordinary shares held of record by Funtery. The Class B ordinary shares are convertible into Class A ordinary shares at any time at the option of the holder thereof on a one-for-one basis.
